ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a food web; the plant on the left is labeled Spartina; there is an arrow from Spartina pointing to the insect Prokelisia. Prokelisia is also connected by arrows to other predators, such as Pardosa, Grammonota, Tytthus, and Hogna. Reasoning: primary consumer refers to an organism that directly eats producers. Spartina is a producer, and the one in the figure that directly receives energy from Spartina is Prokelisia, so the primary consumer is Prokelisia.
